dct_description_sm:
The Brampton Plan Greenbelt Plan area identifies provincially protected lands that support agricultural resources, natural heritage systems, water resources, and environmental sustainability. These lands are protected from urban expansion and help maintain the long-term ecological health and resilience of the broader region.
 

This data is intended to be used in conjuction with other related mapping layers for this schedule, and may be impacted by other schedules, with consideration to the text of Brampton Plan.
